description:
Reid Let's Roll 250W eBike | Commuter Bike
Comfortable, practical and designed for everyday journeys – the Reid Let's Roll eBike is a step-through electric commuter bike built for relaxed city riding, daily commuting and exploring light trails with ease.
The Reid Let's Roll combines a stylish design with dependable electric assistance, making it an ideal choice for riders looking for a comfortable and convenient way to get around. Its lightweight 6061 alloy frame features internal cable routing and an integrated 36V 10Ah 360Wh battery for a clean, streamlined finish. The low-step frame makes getting on and off the bike simple, while its considered design supports a comfortable riding experience.
A 250W rear hub motor delivers smooth, consistent electric assistance, helping you tackle hills and cover longer distances with less effort. The Ananda D19 handlebar-mounted display keeps essential ride information within easy reach, with Bluetooth technology and app compatibility for added functionality. An L-TWOO 7-speed trigger shifter paired with a Shimano rear derailleur provides reliable gearing options for navigating city streets, cycle paths and gentle inclines.
Designed for comfort and control, the Let's Roll features wide 27.5 x 2.1-inch commuter tyres that provide added cushioning and stability across uneven roads and light trails. Tektro hydraulic disc brakes deliver responsive, controlled stopping power in varying riding conditions, giving you greater confidence when navigating busy streets and changing terrain.
Every detail is designed to support a relaxed, comfortable ride. The 640mm swept-back alloy riser handlebar encourages an upright riding position, while comfortable rubber grips and a plush city comfort saddle help make everyday journeys more enjoyable. An alloy ahead stem completes the practical, durable setup, creating an electric hybrid bike suited to regular use.
Whether you're commuting to work, running errands around town or enjoying a leisurely weekend ride, the Reid Let's Roll eBike makes everyday cycling more comfortable and accessible. With smooth electric assistance, a convenient low-step frame and comfort-focused components, it's a versatile choice for riders looking to travel efficiently and enjoy more time on two wheels.
The Reid Let's Roll eBike is ideal for:

Everyday commuters looking for a comfortable electric hybrid bike for travelling to work and getting around town

Riders who prefer easy access, with a low-step frame that makes mounting and dismounting straightforward

Comfort-focused cyclists, with an upright riding position, swept-back handlebars, rubber grips and a plush city comfort saddle

Riders tackling hills and longer journeys, with a 250W rear hub motor providing smooth electric assistance

City and urban riding, with wide 27.5 x 2.1-inch commuter tyres for stability and cushioning on roads and cycle paths

Cyclists exploring light trails, with a versatile hybrid design suited to a variety of everyday riding surfaces

Riders seeking reliable braking performance, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes for controlled stopping power

Cyclists who value connected technology, with an Ananda D19 display featuring Bluetooth technology and app compatibility

Anyone looking for a practical alternative to driving, making everyday journeys more active, convenient and enjoyable

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike and eScooter safety information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.
